scope: Diagnostic action searches on 15 cm, 45 deg stairs; not full-route trials or accepted dataset episodes.
replay_instructions: Load original scene and initial_integration_state from seed NPZ, mj_setState once at original initial time, then replay every prefix_ctrl row and every indexed candidate controls row with one mj_step per row. Do not initialize candidate by branch_qpos. Use prefix_time and candidate track times for scene cursor. Candidate controls are already clipped actual torques, not speed targets.
geometry_limitations: approx_worst_rear_bottom=z-radius omits tilted cylinder half-length extent. Any future crossing requires independent exact cylinder extent and terminal sustained support checks. All current candidates are unambiguously non-crossing because worst rear x remains <1.6m.
